title: UNI-Bridge
tagline: UNI Bridge for All BlockChains, with stake/bridge/trade modules
description:
This project use a logic that only signed tx have the permission to make evm blockchain modify. It provide a smoothly UI for user to bridge any assets from and to any chains.
It includes these modules:
1. stake: user can stake their stETH and mint AO and $veUB token, the staking have multiple season, the first season have the most count of token mint amount.
2. Bridge: user can bridge assets(ERC20, NFT, ERC1155) from and to anychians.
3. Trade: user have a PERPETUAL protoocol to trade with the token/assets their bridged.
how_its_made:
This project use the viem.sh sdk to make the signed tx verification happen. It build with Nuxt, NuxtUI, TailwindCSS, Also use the EIP2535(diamond protocol) as the solidity coding framwork.
1. NuxtUI/Nuxt: build the frontend, very good and easy to use framework, which base on Vue
2. EIP2535: The best artichture of the large scale solidity code in the world
